instrument: Conditional use permit and community benefits agreement, Armory Innovation Data Center (Apr 21, 2026)
summary: Board of Public Service approved a conditional use permit for a 120 MW data center at the former Famous-Barr warehouse. The community benefits agreement requires escalating median-wage job minimums for 20 years (25, 50, then 100) with $2,000 liquidated damages per job short; $15,000 for every $100,000 below projected annual tax revenue if targets are not met by 2029; no local tax abatement; about $15 million to a city fund ($30 per sq ft); operation by Q4 2028. A Project Labor Agreement with the AFL-CIO covers construction.

source.citation: Mayor's office release; city project summary

notes: City states it is the only such agreement it knows of for a data center taking no incentives. Developers include Contour, TerraWatt and THO Investments.
confidence_note: Read on the Mayor's release and the city's project summary; the CBA itself not read.
